run_xmanager_help: run the xmanager CLI help command to display available launch and cluster subcommands
run_xmanager_launch: run the xmanager launch command to launch an experiment using a specified launch script
run_xmanager_cluster_create: run the xmanager cluster create command to create a GKE cluster for use with xm_local
run_xmanager_cluster_delete: run the xmanager cluster delete command to delete a GKE cluster for use with xm_local
run_xmanager_entrypoint: run the xmanager CLI entrypoint to start the command-line interface with absl.app.run
